item.description:
Onda for Mac beta 114 tightens automatic updates after an independent Fable review.
- Background downloads wait for you to quit Onda. They do not restart your music. - If a call, video or tuning session postpones a manual update, Onda now waits for a fresh Restart to Update click. Ending the session never triggers that restart. - Failed or cancelled update sessions clear stale install controls. Background checks postponed by a session retry when idle. - Both the update feed and downloads require cryptographic signatures. Release publishing now downloads and verifies the actual public file before updating the feed. - Includes the existing Meet, Zoom and FaceTime protection, same-volume speaker restoration, Spotify controls and room tuning.
The final source passed 265 Swift tests (five environment-dependent skips) and four offline publisher security tests. A separate updater-only test app using the final updater source completed a real signed download and explicit install/relaunch, including simulated call protection, without touching the running audio app. Both Mac architectures are included. The app and DMG are Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled.
Users on beta 113 can receive this through Onda. It installs on normal quit, or when you explicitly choose Restart to Update while idle. Users on beta 112 or earlier need one manual download to enable automatic updates. Saved speaker settings and room measurements are retained. Finish calls before intentionally quitting or restarting the audio app.
Universal Apple silicon and Intel app; macOS 14+ (Spotify sharing requires 14.2+). This remains a beta; fresh-machine driver installation and generic-output compatibility retain the limits described on the website. Onda Room for iPhone is still awaiting Apple review.
